_doc: Career mode (js/career.js logic, menu.js / garage.js / missions.js glue). You start with one of the 'starters' (owned, stock) and 'money' pesos, and buy the other bikes and every non-stock part option with cash earned from quests ('jobs', paid on a finished quest by stars) and from giving townspeople rides (their fare, x fareX). Bike price = srp (approximate Philippine SRP in pesos, 2025) x priceScale, rounded to 10. Part option price = parts[key][0] x the bike's tier (sqrt(price / tierRef), clamped to tierMin..tierMax) x (1 + parts[key][1] x rank), rank = 0 for the first non-stock option of the list, 1 for the next and so on (lists run from mild to wild); keys missing from parts use partDefault. The stock option (the bike's default) is always owned; a bought option stays owned on that bike. Sliders, assists and custom colours are free (adjustments, not parts). Selling a bike returns sellBack of its price (parts are lost). Fuel at the station costs fuel pesos a litre. Saved career: localStorage cpm.career (bikes, parts, stats) + cpm.career.wallet / cpm.career.bag (the shop.js wallet in career).
